data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: opinion
sections.summary: A personal view or belief about something, not necessarily based on fact.

senses.definition: a personal view, belief, or judgement about something, not necessarily based on fact or knowledge
examples: In my opinion, the second option is the better choice.

answers.answer: In my opinion, this plan will work.
In my opinion, this plan will works.

sections.question: personality
sections.summary: The combination of qualities and characteristics that make a person unique.

senses.definition: the combination of qualities, characteristics, and behaviours that make a person different from everyone else
examples: He has a warm and outgoing personality that everyone admires.

answers.answer: Her friendly personality makes her popular.
Her friendly personality make her popular.

sections.question: perspective
sections.summary: A particular way of thinking about or viewing a situation or subject.

senses.definition: a particular way of considering or judging a situation or subject; a point of view shaped by personal experience or position
examples: Travel can give you a new perspective on life.

answers.answer: Try to see the problem from a different perspective.
Try to see the problem from different perspective.

sections.question: self-esteem
sections.summary: Confidence in and respect for yourself and your own abilities and worth.

senses.definition: confidence in your own worth and abilities; respect and belief in yourself as a capable and valuable person
examples: Completing the course helped her self-esteem enormously.

answers.answer: Good feedback can improve the self-esteem.

sections.question: sentiment
sections.summary: A feeling or opinion held by a person or group about a particular topic.

senses.definition: a view, feeling, or attitude, especially one shared by many people; an opinion expressed through or based on emotion
examples: Public sentiment towards the new policy was mostly positive.

answers.answer: There is growing sentiment against the policy.
There is a growing sentiment against the policy.

sections.question: skill
sections.summary: The ability to do something well, usually developed through training or practice.

senses.definition: the ability to do something well as a result of training, practice, or natural talent
examples: Good communication is an essential skill in any workplace.

sections.question: talent
sections.summary: A natural ability or aptitude for something, especially one that can be developed.

senses.definition: a natural ability or aptitude for something, especially one that can be further developed with practice
examples: She showed a real talent for painting from a very early age.

answers.answer: He has a talent for music.

sections.question: traits
sections.summary: Particular and distinguishing qualities or characteristics of a person's personality.

senses.definition: particular and distinguishing qualities or characteristics of a person's personality or behaviour
examples: Kindness and honesty are traits that people admire greatly.

answers.answer: Patience and honesty are important traits.
Patience and honesty are an important traits.

sections.question: view
sections.summary: A personal opinion or belief about a particular subject or issue.

senses.definition: a personal opinion, belief, or attitude about a particular subject or issue
examples: In my view, the project needs more planning before we start.

answers.answer: In my view, we should leave early.
In my view, we should to leave early.

sections.question: wisdom
sections.summary: The ability to make good judgements and decisions based on knowledge and experience.

senses.definition: the quality of having good judgement and understanding, based on knowledge and experience accumulated over time
examples: The older students shared their wisdom with those just starting the course.

answers.answer: He shared his wisdom with the younger students.
He shared his wisdoms with the younger students.
A wisdom is a type of skill.
